changes: More natural narration: the app no longer pitch-shifts one voice; it picks the best installed offline voices (two distinct voices for leader and response).
Settings > Reading voice: choose leader and response voices with preview, and a shortcut to Android's TTS settings to download better free offline voices.
Code for M6 (orders/offices) and M7 (devotions) is in place; content arrives with T-016 to T-019.
known_limitations: Voice selection not verified on a real device or engine (Robolectric exposes no voices).
